description_en: Queries the slow query log details of an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查看实例的慢日志明细
name: DescribeSlowLogRecords

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the SQL statement in the slow query log statistics. You can use this parameter to obtain the slow query log details of the SQL statement
parameters.help_zh: 慢日志统计里的SQL语句唯一标识符，可用于获取该SQL语句的慢日志明细
parameters.name: sql_ha_sh

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. The start time must be within the last 30 days. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，最大不能早于当前时间30天。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，需要晚于查询开始时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: 30 to 100.

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：30~100。

默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number. Valid values: any integer greater than 0 that does not exceed the maximum value of Integer.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The node ID.
<notice>This parameter is applicable only to Cluster Edition instances. You can specify this parameter to query the logs of a specific node. If you do not specify this parameter, the logs of the primary node are returned by default.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
节点ID。
<notice>该参数仅适用于集群版实例，可以选择查询指定节点日志。若不传该参数，默认返回主节点日志。></notice>
parameters.name: node_id

items.description_en: The details of a slow query log entry
